fields.subject: Grain Persistence
fields.where: the grain type has a configured Query contract
fields.response: derive the Shard identifier and read parameters from the grain identity through the read delegate cached for the Orleans state name (the grainType argument) and the state type TModel; map the configured read result from that Shard into the supplied state, or into a new default TModel instance when the supplied state is null, keeping the mapped result on every mapping branch; when the mapping returns no result (null), create the state with TModel's static IActivator<TModel> factory when TModel implements IActivator<TModel>, otherwise as a default TModel instance whose shard key is set from the grain id through the shard-setting delegate cached for that state name and state type
fields.postcondition: when the read returned a record, the grain-state envelope holds the mapped result and records that its state exists; when it returned none, the envelope holds the newly activated instance and records the state as absent
